title: Through yard
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：through　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 through 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the porter kept the bag ① through the long winter at the cove, and everybody in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the bag had been left ② through the gate of the yard, and nobody had asked a single question. The porter had come to the coast two weeks earlier and spoke little of the coast he had left behind him.

The journal for August 1969 puts it plainer. It was done ③ through the window of the shed, and the visitor who kept the bag had bought it ④ through the help of the old nurse twice before the winter came; nothing in the coast was ever done through the window of the shed in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ through the want of money, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ through the good of the family; he was not a man who explained himself, and the coast had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the bag be bought ⑦ through the eye of a needle, and that the names be written ⑧ through the streets of the town. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried through the eye of a needle.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985 she kept the bag ⑨ through the long winter again when nobody else would, and ⑩ through the gate of the yard, she said in 1987, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the bag in the same cove for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the coast never forgot what had been done through the gate of the yard.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 穿过（表时间：through the long winter）
B. prep. 穿过（表处所：through the gate of the yard）
C. prep. 凭借（表方式／状态：through the window of the shed）
D. prep. 凭借（引出施动者或相关的人：be bought through the help of the old nurse）
E. prep. 穿过（表原因：through the want of money）
F. prep. 凭借（表对象／目的：through the good of the family）
G. prep. 穿过（表工具／材料：through the eye of a needle）
H. prep. 凭借（表载体／处所：written through the streets of the town）

items.q: through the gate of the yard
through the window of the shed
through the help of the old nurse
through the good of the family
through the eye of a needle
through the streets of the town
through the gate of the yard, she said

answers.why: through 意为“穿过”，此处引出时间 the long winter（整个漫长的冬天），说明那件小小的行囊是在何时留下的。
through 意为“穿过”，此处引出处所 the gate of the yard（院门），说明东西被放在何处。
through 意为“凭借”，此处引出方式或状态 the window of the shed（棚屋的窗子），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
through 意为“凭借”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 老护士的帮助：be bought through the help of the old nurse。
through 意为“穿过”，此处引出原因 the want of money（因为缺钱），说明整件事由何而起。
through 意为“凭借”，此处引出对象或目的 the good of the family（一家人的好处）。
through 意为“穿过”，此处引出工具或材料 the eye of a needle（针眼）。
through 意为“凭借”，此处引出载体 the streets of the town（镇上的街道）：names written through the streets of the town。
through 意为“穿过”，1985 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的行囊，此处仍引出时间 the long winter。
through 意为“穿过”，母亲 1987 年那句话引出的仍是那一处院门。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年整个漫长的冬天前后，挑夫把那件小小的行囊留在了小湾。（through the long winter）
那件小小的行囊被放在院门，谁也没有过问。（through the gate of the yard）
整件事是棚屋的窗子做成的，行记上写得明白。（through the window of the shed）
入冬之前，那件小小的行囊已经由老护士的帮助买过两回。（be bought through the help of the old nurse）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为缺钱起的。（through the want of money）
他说，家里从来没有人为一家人的好处做过这件事。（through the good of the family）
answers: In 1975 the porter kept the bag through the long winter at the cove.
The bag had been left through the gate of the yard, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done through the window of the shed, or so the journal says.
The bag had been bought through the help of the old nurse twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun through the want of money.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it through the good of the family.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 through 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the porter kept the bag through the long winter, and nobody forgot it.
The bag had been left through the gate of the yard for three weeks.
The work was done through the window of the shed, as it always was in those days.
The bag had been bought through the help of the old nurse twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the bag through the long winter again when nobody else would.
The whole coast never forgot what had been done through the gate of the yard.
